issues.problem: The English adds 'his courage known to every state' after 'raised to shangqing'; the Chinese field only says 拜为上卿 with no claim about his reputation for courage (that detail appears in the Chinese only in sections.hook.0).
issues.suggestion: Drop ', his courage known to every state' here, or add 以勇气闻名诸侯 to the Chinese.

issues.problem: The Chinese 秦王与群臣相视而嘻 says the king and his ministers looked at one another and gave a wry laugh/scoff; the English renders only 'looked at one another', dropping the 嘻 reaction that signals their helpless amusement.
issues.suggestion: Use 'The king and his ministers looked at one another and laughed wryly.'

overall: The two editions match closely in facts, quotations, dates and hedges; only one dropped detail in the Qin-court scene and one phrase added in English are worth touching.
